Giver: Hi, I'm giving you directions. Okay, start at the cross.
Follower: Okay, got the cross.
Giver: Head towards the cliffs.
Follower: Which way? Up or down?
Giver: Down and slightly right. Pass close to the cliffs on your left.
Follower: Right, so I go past the cliffs on the left.
Giver: Good. Keep going down.
Follower: Okay.
Giver: Next, head towards the forge.
Follower: Wait, I don't see a forge on my map.
Giver: Ah, you don't? Okay, then head towards the old pine.
Follower: Okay, towards the old pine.
Giver: Pass the old pine on your right.
Follower: Right, past the pine on the right.
Giver: Now turn right and head towards the pine forest.
Follower: Okay, turning right towards the forest.
Giver: Pass the forest on your left.
Follower: Done, forest on left.
Giver: Keep going down a bit, then head right towards the bakery.
Follower: Okay, heading to the bakery.
Giver: Pass the bakery on your right.
Follower: Right, bakery is on the right.
Giver: Great. Now look for the canal.
Follower: Oh, I see a canal, but it's way over here.
Giver: Which way?
Follower: It's further east, past the bakery.
Giver: Okay, ignore that. Head towards the crane bay.
Follower: Okay, heading to the crane bay.
Giver: Pass the crane bay on your left.
Follower: Right, bay on the left.
Giver: Keep going. Look for the wheatfields.
Follower: I see the wheatfields.
Giver: Pass the wheatfields on your right.
Follower: Okay, wheatfields on the right.
Giver: Good. Now look for the rocket warehouse.
Follower: I see the rocket warehouse.
Giver: Pass the rocket warehouse on your left.
Follower: Right, warehouse on the left.
Giver: Continue down towards the old lighthouse.
Follower: Okay, heading to the lighthouse.
Giver: Pass the lighthouse on your left.
Follower: Right, lighthouse on the left.
Giver: Keep going until you hit the finish line.
Follower: Okay, I see the finish line now.
Giver: Are you there?
Follower: Yes, I'm at the cross.
Giver: Excellent. You're done.
